title: Anthropic递交上市文件 估值或达1.5万亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, it finally happened. The Anthropic IPO S1 filing, now just hitting.
segments.zh: 终于来了，Anthropic的IPO S1文件刚刚发布。

segments.en: Intense list on the NASDAQ, under the TICCA and ANT.
segments.zh: 即将登陆纳斯达克，代码为TICCA和ANT。

segments.en: The S1 filing is a document submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission, which allows investors to look under the hood of a company.
segments.zh: S1文件是提交给美国证券交易委员会的文件，让市场参与者得以深入了解公司内部情况。

segments.en: For the first time, the public will really be able to analyze these company's financials and just how much money they're not only making, but potentially losing.
segments.zh: 公众将首次能够真正分析这些公司的财务状况，以及它们不仅赚了多少钱，还可能亏了多少钱。

segments.en: This is a critical moment for AI. It's a critical moment for the public market.
segments.zh: 这是AI的关键时刻，也是公开市场的关键时刻。

segments.en: The most shocking thing is this is a company that's only six years old and wants to rewrite the history books for the largest IPO in human history.
segments.zh: 最令人震惊的是，这是一家仅成立六年的公司，却想改写人类历史上最大IPO的纪录。

segments.en: Anthropic is targeting to raise even more than SpaceX's IPO of 86.25 billion, and its valuation has shifted from 1.4 trillion
segments.zh: Anthropic的目标是筹集甚至超过SpaceX的862.5亿IPO规模，其估值已从1.4万亿

segments.en: to 1.5 trillion. The S1 also shows that in the first six months of 2026, the company had 16.3 billion in revenue,
segments.zh: 美元升至1.5万亿美元。S1文件还显示，2026年前六个月，公司营收为163亿美元，

segments.en: but also net losses of 80.7 billion. In the same period last year, revenue was 1.16 billion with net losses of 13 billion.
segments.zh: 但净亏损达807亿美元。去年同期，营收为11.6亿美元，净亏损为130亿美元。

segments.en: To put that into context, its revenue has jumped more than 10 fold in the last 12 months.
segments.zh: 对比来看，其营收在过去12个月增长了超过10倍。

segments.en: But is that revenue has jumped, so have its costs.
segments.zh: 但收入增长的同时，成本也在上升。

segments.en: This is a company that needs to spend to compete. It is spending against some of the best capitalized companies in the world.
segments.zh: 这是一家需要投入资金来竞争的公司。它正与全球资本最雄厚的公司展开投入竞争。

segments.en: And it's spending on compute power.
